Opinion of the Judge Accused  JUDGMENT

The Assistant Commissioner of Police, Halasuru Sub- Division, Bangalore, has submitted charge sheet against the accused for the offences punishable U/s.498A and 304B of IPC in Crime No.21/2015 of Halasuru P.S., Bengaluru.

2. The factual matrix of the case is that:
The marriage of accused was solemnized with the deceased Smt.Mamatha daughter of informant on 20.12.2015 as per the customs prevailed in their community at Haliyala, and at the time of marriage the accused on demand received Rs.5,00,000/-
cash, gold articles as dowry from the informant and after the marriage, when the deceased started residing along with accused in a rented house at Bovi Street,
Halasuru, within the limits of Halasuru P.S., Bangalore, the accused subjected the deceased to physical and mental cruelty by demanding additional dowry in terms of Rs.10,00,000/-.

The daughter of informant unable to tolerate the harassment of SC No.218/2016 accused by feeling hurt and disgusting and such cruelty and harassment did drive the said deceased-Smt. Mamatha to commit suicide by hanging on 3.1.2015 at her matrimonial house, within a period of seven years of marriage, subjected her to cruelty and harassment in connection with the demand for additional dowry and thereby the accused has committed the offences as alleged.
Initially case has been registered vide UDR No.1/2015 dated 4.1.2015 U/s.174 of Cr.P.C.,

Thereafter the case has been registered against the accused on the complaint of complainant-Smt.
Neelamma on 17.01.2015 in Crime No.21/2015 for the offences punishable U/s.304B of IPC.
3.
The concerned police have submitted charge sheet before the jurisdictional X ACMM., Bangalore.

The learned Magistrate after taking cognizance for the offence punishable U/ s.498A and 304B of IPC, committed the case to the Sessions Court by complying Sec.207 of Cr.P.C., furnishing charge sheet copies to the accused.

After the receipt of the committal records, the same was allotted to this Court and numbered as SC No.218/2016.
4.

The charge was framed, read over and explained to the accused on 6.2.2017 for the offence punishable 304B r/w sec.34 of IPC and additional charge framed on 6.7.2017 for the offences punishable U/s.498A and 304B of IPC and Sec.3 and 4 of DP Act in the language known to the accused and for which the accused pleaded not guilty and claims to be tried.
